changes: Two-page branded Repair & Renovation Agreement PDF (generateAgreementPdf): front page = logo, BGRE Home Touchups and Repairs division name, walk-through hero photo, pre-filled client info, itemized scope/total/deposit, 3-line signature block; back page = full 13-section terms in two columns

Three signing paths: Print & Sign (admin downloads blank PDF, later records signer name via mark-print-signed), E-Sign (existing client quote link, now renders full agreementSections instead of a short bullet list), one-click green Approve Proposal email (sendApprovalEmail + /repair-quote/:token?mode=approve)
generate-quote endpoint now also produces the blank agreement PDF up front; accept endpoint now persists signature_method and regenerates a signed agreement PDF

New 'Consults' tab in the admin Repair Program panel (RepairPricingVendorPanel.tsx) listing all repair_consults with per-row Send to Client (E-Sign), Send Approval Email, Download Print & Sign PDF, and Mark as Print-Signed actions
__bundleNotes: No removed client-facing copy in this release (the short terms bullet list was replaced by full agreementSections rendering, but 'terms' as a word is too common to use as a must-not-contain guard). Hero photo, signature-block name/date/IP, and dollar totals are server-provided at runtime, not bundle string literals — not verifiable via Layer 2.
